name: service-view-statements
title: Services · consumption and team statements · platform
description: Platform reconciliation by attributed user/team. Consumer delivery uses an explicitly scoped offline statement; native self-only MaaS views remain a separate qualified capability.

report.title: Selected immutable service report
report.description: Read evidence, estimate/closed status, period, policy, price basis and cost scope before using money. No live authorization is configured for these detached platform candidates.

complete.title: Evidence complete (1=yes)
complete.description: Missing evidence is not zero. Completeness does not by itself establish invoice reconciliation or accepted task quality.

charges.title: Attributed charges (USD cents)
charges.description: Charges by user, team, model, offer and category. Unattributed user rows can be legitimate team availability or reservation charges. Never redistribute them through a dashboard filter.

known.title: Known charges, possibly incomplete (USD cents)
known.description: Known portions are diagnostic and must not be presented as full totals when completeness is false.

quantities.title: Billable quantities in their own units
quantities.description: Do not add unlike units or overlapping provider categories. Rates and categories are taken from this report snapshot.

rates.title: Snapshot rate provenance
rates.description: Value 1 identifies a retained rate/source, not a monetary value. Editable dashboard defaults are not pricing authority.

agreementContext.title: Agreement cost and contract basis
agreementContext.description: Invoice, metered estimate and supplied actual costs remain distinct. Metadata is retained with this immutable report, not read from current configuration.

name: service-view-dedicated
title: Services · dedicated service efficiency · platform
description: Financial context for dedicated capacity. Reuse native LLM Utilization, Performance and Traffic for GPU, queue, TTFT/ITL and errors. No request/team GPU-time attribution is inferred.

report.title: Selected immutable service report
report.description: Read evidence, estimate/closed status, period, policy, price basis and cost scope before using money. No live authorization is configured for these detached platform candidates.

complete.title: Evidence complete (1=yes)
complete.description: Missing evidence is not zero. Completeness does not by itself establish invoice reconciliation or accepted task quality.

cost.title: Dedicated actual full cost (USD cents)
cost.description: Use with paid availability evidence and native operational views. The sponsor owns idle capacity under the agreement.

charge.title: Dedicated sponsor charge (USD cents)
charge.description: Charges and actual cost remain separate: a fixed quote does not become actual infrastructure cost.

variance.title: Dedicated recovery balance (USD cents)
variance.description: Report-defined charges plus subsidy minus actual cost; negative means under-recovery. No cost is inferred from GPU utilization.

components.title: Dedicated cost components (USD cents)
components.description: Only included cost components from the immutable report. Fullness depends on declared scope and evidence.

tokens.title: Dedicated measured total tokens
tokens.description: Zero use does not remove paid availability cost. Use native serving metrics for performance and the task view for instrumented accepted outcomes.

agreementContext.title: Agreement cost and contract basis
agreementContext.description: Invoice, metered estimate and supplied actual costs remain distinct. Metadata is retained with this immutable report, not read from current configuration.

name: service-view-shared
title: Services · shared service economics · platform
description: Published tariff recovery is separate from proportional infrastructure allocation. Zero-demand under-recovery remains visible; ratios are absent when actual cost is zero.

report.title: Selected immutable service report
report.description: Read evidence, estimate/closed status, period, policy, price basis and cost scope before using money. No live authorization is configured for these detached platform candidates.

complete.title: Evidence complete (1=yes)
complete.description: Missing evidence is not zero. Completeness does not by itself establish invoice reconciliation or accepted task quality.

cost.title: Shared actual cost (USD cents)
cost.description: Actual cost scope belongs to the selected report.

charges.title: Shared tariff/reservation charges (USD cents)
charges.description: Uses the report's published prices and explicit reservation credits. Historical totals are not recalculated here.

subsidy.title: Explicit subsidy (USD cents)
subsidy.description: Subsidy is an explicit financing input, not hidden usage revenue.

balance.title: Shared recovery balance (USD cents)
balance.description: Charges + subsidy - actual cost, from the closed calculation. Negative is under-recovery.

ratio.title: Recovery before subsidy (ratio)
ratio.description: Undefined when actual cost is zero; never shown as zero in that case.

ratioSubsidy.title: Recovery after subsidy (ratio)
ratioSubsidy.description: Includes subsidy once. Ratio 1 means recovery equals actual included cost.

agreementContext.title: Agreement cost and contract basis
agreementContext.description: Invoice, metered estimate and supplied actual costs remain distinct. Metadata is retained with this immutable report, not read from current configuration.

name: service-view-completeness
title: Services · accounting completeness · platform
description: Platform-only reconciliation. Unknown invoice, price or cost is omitted rather than zero. Durable monthly continuity is checked by the close/archive workflow, not a time-series extrapolation.

report.title: Selected immutable service report
report.description: Read evidence, estimate/closed status, period, policy, price basis and cost scope before using money. No live authorization is configured for these detached platform candidates.

complete.title: Evidence complete (1=yes)
complete.description: Missing evidence is not zero. Completeness does not by itself establish invoice reconciliation or accepted task quality.

prices.title: Pricing completeness (1=yes)
prices.description: No full charge is published for an agreement with incomplete price evidence.

costs.title: Cost completeness (1=yes)
costs.description: Known costs are not a complete cost basis when evidence is missing.

usage.title: Usage completeness (1=yes)
usage.description: Sampled traces cannot complete missing usage. Native request success is not task acceptance.

invoice.title: Provider invoice (USD cents)
invoice.description: Only emitted when invoice evidence exists in this report.

difference.title: Invoice difference (USD cents)
difference.description: A known difference remains visible even when the statement is closed. Follow report reconciliation and adjustment evidence.

known.title: Known fleet cost portion (USD cents)
known.description: Diagnostic known portion. Incomplete price/cost evidence prevents claiming a full total.

charges.title: Fleet charges (USD cents)
charges.description: Total of attributable charge lines, including adjustments; not a provider invoice or total infrastructure cost.

agreementContext.title: Agreement cost and contract basis
agreementContext.description: Invoice, metered estimate and supplied actual costs remain distinct. Metadata is retained with this immutable report, not read from current configuration.

name: service-view-quality
title: Services · workload quality and sourcing · platform
description: Optional service_advice snapshot for the same period/currency/evidence kind. Reuse MLflow GenAI Traces/Sessions for instrumented workflow drilldown. These projections are analytical, not invoice money.

report.title: Selected immutable service report
report.description: Read evidence, estimate/closed status, period, policy, price basis and cost scope before using money. No live authorization is configured for these detached platform candidates.

complete.title: Evidence complete (1=yes)
complete.description: Missing evidence is not zero. Completeness does not by itself establish invoice reconciliation or accepted task quality.

advice.title: Analysis identity and conclusion
advice.description: Only present when an analysis snapshot was explicitly supplied. Request/task identifiers stay in evidence records, not metric labels.

accepted.title: Accepted tasks
accepted.description: Explicit accepted outcomes, not HTTP success. Missing instrumentation leaves this panel empty.

retries.title: Corrective retries
retries.description: Corrective retries are separate from planned multi-turn work.

turns.title: Planned turns
turns.description: Normal multi-turn workflow is not automatically a model failure.

cost.title: Workflow cost per accepted task (USD cents)
cost.description: Includes the analysis cohort's failed/retried/fallback attempts. Undefined at zero accepted tasks.

savings.title: Projected sourcing savings (USD cents)
savings.description: Only compare capacity-qualified scenarios with matched quality/SLO. An infeasible private scenario has no fabricated savings.

payback.title: Migration payback (months)
payback.description: Analytical estimate; undefined when there are no positive recurring savings.

agreementContext.title: Agreement cost and contract basis
agreementContext.description: Invoice, metered estimate and supplied actual costs remain distinct. Metadata is retained with this immutable report, not read from current configuration.
